summary: Verified Kagane private extensions repo (keiyoushi format) hosted at https://kagane-patch.preview.emergentagent.com/repo/. All 11 pytest assertions pass covering index.pb (gzip+protobuf parse, name='Jo Private', badgeLabel='JO', signingKey matches APK cert SHA-256), extension metadata (packageName, versionName 1.6.33, versionCode 106033, extensionLib 1.6, contentWarning MIXED), 18 sources with IDs exactly matching upstream keiyoushi (library compatibility preserved), index.json consistency with index.pb, no 'emergent' branding outside hosting URL, apk/jar/icon URLs 200 with sha256 matches, jar signed by CN=Jo Private Extensions, and APK cert SHA-256 equals index signingKey (e2b9220aba679d713db81ac3356abef5c3f5f480d837e387b2d578977bfe66b6).

critical_code_review_comments: Repo structure matches keiyoushi exactly: /repo/index.pb (gzipped protobuf), /repo/index.json (mirror), /repo/apk/*.apk+.jar, /repo/icon/*.png — Mihon can consume this URL as a private extension repo.
signingKey in index.pb/json equals the APK v2 signing certificate SHA-256 (same derivation keiyoushi uses). Mihon will trust this APK for self-updates since cert fingerprint will match.

Source IDs are byte-identical to upstream keiyoushi for packageName eu.kanade.tachiyomi.extension.all.kagane across all 18 languages — users migrating from the keiyoushi repo keep all existing library entries.
No 'emergent' strings in metadata other than the hosting URL domain. Repo name = 'Jo Private', badge = 'JO'.

JDK21 at /root/jdk/jdk-21* and apksigner at /root/android/build-tools/37.0.0/lib/apksigner.jar.
